sites.Basis: Highest zone score on site (Z01, 9) on N3, supported by crossing line E4; not at a line end; low on oblique sections S2 and S6 (100-130 m)
Z06 (score 7, 110-170 m) in both N8 records; strongest site on the depth slices (150-160 m and 220-280 m) and on oblique section S4; 146 m from A
Z02 (score 8, 110-150 m) on N7 with E4 support, but weak on the 3D model, depth slices and oblique sections S3/S8; 100 m from A, 85 m from B
Z03 (score 8, 100-220 m) on N4 with E5 support; 55 m from A, so drilled only if A fails
Z09 (score 7) on E5 with N2 support; Z09, Z07 and Z10 all touch a line end; 50 m from A
Z04 (score 8) on E6 with N5 support; 7.5 m from the boundary
Z05 (score 8) on E6 with N3 support; 3.4 m from the boundary, on a drainage line

interp.approved_by: Dr. A. Antony Alosanai Promilton (instruction: decide from all sides - positive, neutral, negative)
interp.rule: mean shape_z <= -0.5 -> HP-L; >= +0.5 -> HP-H; low persistence with large local anomaly/gradient -> HP-N; else HP-B

I-POS.label: positive
I-POS.meaning: every relatively low-response class may be fractured and water-bearing

I-NEU.label: neutral
I-NEU.meaning: only the clearly low-response class (HP-L) may be fractured and water-bearing

I-NEG.label: negative
I-NEG.meaning: the low-response class is clay/gouge-filled (conductive but low K); ADMT shows no permeable zone

interp.how_to_approve: copy to sites/<site>/06_interpretation/class_interpretation_v1.yaml, edit, set approved: true, approved_by and approved_on
interp.approval_note: No single reading is adopted; I-POS, I-NEU and I-NEG are carried in parallel until borehole evidence (M9)
